source.title: Larne Times, 9 May 1936, p. 2 ("Larne urban council nominations")
source.publisher: Larne Times (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: 'Nominations had been received on behalf of the retiring members only, therefore he declared them elected without the necessity of polling.'

note: Annual election of five urban councillors, one for each ward, poll due 15 May 1936; the retiring members were the only nominations and were declared elected without a poll (Larne Times, 9 May 1936, p. 2). Returned unopposed.
